LOGIN.TAGLINE: Manage your school with ease: students, groups, attendance and payments.
LOGIN.TITLE: Sign in
LOGIN.SUBTITLE: Enter your credentials to access the application.

USERS.TITLE: Account management
USERS.SUBTITLE: Create, enable/disable and reset user accounts.

IMPORT.TITLE: CSV Import
IMPORT.HINT: Import your data from CSV files (with a header row). Valid rows are created, errors are listed.

STUDENTS.TITLE: Students
STUDENTS.COLUMNS: Columns: firstName, lastName, gender, level, establishment, phoneNumber (firstName and lastName required)

TEACHERS.TITLE: Teachers
TEACHERS.COLUMNS: Columns: firstName, lastName, specialization, phoneNumber, email (firstName and lastName required)

GROUPS.TITLE: Groups
GROUPS.COLUMNS: Columns: name, groupType, level, subject, teacherFirstName, teacherLastName, sessionNumberPerSerie, price (name, level, subject required)
GROUPS.NOTE: Levels, subjects, types, teachers and pricing must already exist. Import teachers and pricing before groups. The price column refers to an existing price by its amount: without it, the group is created but cannot collect any payment. Each group is attached to the current school year.

LEVELS.TITLE: Levels
LEVELS.COLUMNS: Columns: name, levelCode, levelSequence (name required; levelSequence = promotion rank, recommended)

PRICING.TITLE: Pricing (price per session)
PRICING.COLUMNS: Columns: price (required). The price is then linked to a group via the form.
